title: Course: CS C281B | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Course: CS C281B | EECS at UC Berkeley CS C281B. Advanced Topics in Learning and Decision Making Catalog Description: Recent topics include: Graphical models and approximate inference algorithms. Markov chain Monte Carlo, mean field and probability propagation methods. Model selection and stochastic realization. Bayesian information theoretic and structural risk minimization approaches. Markov decision processes and partially observable Markov decision processes. Reinforcement learning. Units: 3 Also Offered As: STAT C241B Related Areas: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Formats: Spring: 3 hours of lecture per week Fall: 3 hours of lecture per week Grading Basis: letter Final Exam Status: No final exam Class Schedule (Spring 2026): CS C281B – We 14:00-16:59, Evans 344 – Jason Lee Links: EECS Course Archives (CalNet authentication required) CS enrollment policies EE enrollment policies HKN course maps
